authority: #K2-350 sec.3.4 (one bounded re-drawing window) - the contract is RESOLVED in R906, so this is the one-shot path + the named deviation the ruling requires if one-pin parts are not expressible

contract_RESOLVED.forward: every YAML node REF/PIN must match a pin that EXISTS IN THE SCHEMATIC (match = schematic pin function startswith the YAML pin name) - checks.py:115-121
contract_RESOLVED.reverse: every schematic pin that is NOT in the YAML must be declared nc in the placement block ('sheets[].placements[].nc') - checks.py:123-133
contract_RESOLVED.CONSEQUENCE: a TEST POINT has NO schematic symbol instance => it can never satisfy the forward assertion => ONE-PIN PARTS ARE NOT EXPRESSIBLE by a netlist-only edit. R906 said this; this artifact acts on it.

E1_v2_netlist_only.schematic_edits: NONE (the schematic is approval-gated and is NOT touched)
E1_v2_netlist_only.scope: J11 ONLY - which is exactly the no-TP alternative the ruling pre-authorised (keep J9/J6)
E1_v2_netlist_only.why_J11_is_safe_without_TPs: R894 pad census: removing J11 leaves I2C2_SCL 3 pads, I2C2_SDA 3 pads, P3V3_AUX 5 pads - no net becomes single-ended, so NO test point is needed

edits.and: the J11 placement block gains '    nc: [EC_SCL, EC_SDA, EC_3V3]' (plus every other J11 pin that the YAML nets no longer carry) so the REVERSE assertion is satisfied

edits.what: NO CHANGE (no TPs are added in this path)

E1_v2_netlist_only.not_touched: J9 and J6 keep their placements and their nets (UART_TX/RX and PWR_CTRL_OUT stay connected, 2 pads each) - their governance is DEFERRED because it needs test points, i.e. a schematic-capable change

deviation_declaration_required_by_the_ru.what_is_deviated: the header governance lands for J11 only; J9 (UART) and J6 (PWR_CTRL_OUT) are DEFERRED rather than removed
deviation_declaration_required_by_the_ru.why: removing J9/J6 leaves each of their nets with exactly ONE pad (R894 census: PWR_CTRL_OUT {J6,U5}, UART_TX {J9,U1}, UART_RX {J9,U1}); converting them to test points requires a schematic symbol instance, and one-pin parts are not expressible netlist-only (contract above) - so the choice is between (a) deferring them or (b) an approval-gated schematic change
deviation_declaration_required_by_the_ru.how_the_goal_is_still_met: N8's header policy targets EVALUATION FURNITURE; J11 (auxiliary I2C/SMBus) is the clearest such item and it is governed now. J9/J6 remain evaluation headers temporarily; the policy goal is not abandoned, it is sequenced.
deviation_declaration_required_by_the_ru.evidence: R894 pad census + R906 verbatim contract read; both in register
deviation_declaration_required_by_the_ru.no_owner_item: per #K2-341 sec.2.3 pattern and #K2-350 sec.3.4: layout/header governance is a supervisor-ruled autonomous item, NOT a frozen-set change and NOT an owner item

steps: apply the two edits above (YAML only)
run the claim<->artifact verbatim check BEFORE committing (C25: the commit message may only assert what the diff shows)
commit (the repo's four gates are the oracle)
verify: gates PASS + refmap/netlist consistency + a claim-artifact assertion
one_shot_execution.if_the_gates_reject: STOP and file a report (no iteration) - that behaviour is now the default procedure per #K2-350 sec.3.6

state_now.tp_footprint: kept but inert (C24 stays open as a spare part, named)
state_now.runs_this_turn: none (artifact authored from the R906 read)
